info.title: Academic OS Integration API
info.description: Thin API Integration Facade connecting the React Frontend to the Academic OS Python Learning Intelligence Subsystem.

get.description: Health check for AI subsystems, LLM providers, search, and storage.
Exposes system capabilities, supported content types, and supported languages.
Retrieve the current student profile and concept mastery.

patch.description: Update student learning preferences, course, or preferred language.

get.description:
Get aggregated learning state including Next Best Action,
personalized study plan, spaced repetition queue, and activity history.

post.description:
Primary conversational learning endpoint.
- If document_ids is null or empty: runs Trusted External Discovery (Mode B).
- If document_ids has items: runs selected course material retrieval (Mode A).
- Preserves hierarchical personalization, citations, and evidence limitations.

get.description: List all course materials uploaded for the student.

post.description:
Upload and index a course document (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, .pptx).
Extracts text, generates embeddings, and indexes chunks into Chroma vector store.

Generate one or multiple personalized study tools from the 15 supported kinds:
[explanation, summary, notes, study_guide, flashcards, quiz, exam, practice,
 code, coding_exercise, diagram, presentation, analogy, comparison, question_bank].
- Grounded strictly in uploaded materials or trusted external evidence.
- Zero model-memory fallback for unavailable evidence.
- Supports SVG preview + PPTX download artifacts.

Generate an assessment / diagnostic knowledge check.
- Grounded in uploaded material or trusted external evidence.
- Questions contain MCQs and short answers with an explicit 'I don't know' option.
- Stored in server cache until submitted.

Submit completed answers for evaluation.
- Backend evaluates correctness and updates student mastery.
- React does NOT evaluate or update mastery client-side.

Record student spaced repetition review feedback ('Remembered' or 'Forgot').
Updates Leitner/SM-2 intervals and profile persistence server-side.

get.description:
Download a generated artifact (e.g., SVG diagram, PPTX presentation).
Serves with proper MIME types and headers.

message.title: Message
message.default: File successfully uploaded and indexed into knowledge base.
